note: What a named resonance looks like in the world (key: the name in assets/registry/resonances.json). Every named resonance needs a line here, or the site build fails.
Pale Flame: Cold fire burns slow and pale: it clings to the target longer, and your aim steadies.
Stormfire: A spark carries the flame, and Burning leaps to the nearest enemy.
Boiling Blood: The heat boils the target's blood, and the burn opens bleeding wounds.
Blasting Flame: The blow bursts the fire apart: the target is thrown back and the ground around it catches fire.
Stinging Flame: The point carries the flame inside: a crit always ignites, and the burn eats through the armor.
Burning Frost: The ice holds trapped heat and scalds the target when it thaws.
Ringing Ice: The current rings through the ice and freezes the enemy beside the target.
Chilled Blood: Cold thickens the blood in the target's veins, and its strength drains away.
Cleaving Ice: The blow shatters the ice the target is locked in, and the shards cut deep.
Piercing Frost: You freeze the enemy first, then pierce the frozen spot, dealing more damage, and that hit is automatically a crit.
Incinerating Discharge: The current finds the charge already in the target and sets it alight.
Ice Conduit: The current runs through the ice and bursts into the enemies around the frozen target.
Blood Arc: Current flows easily through blood and arcs from one bleeding enemy to the next.
Thunderclap: The discharge lands like a hammer and can knock the target senseless.
Lightning Needle: The point opens a path for the current: it strikes the target and the enemy beside it, and leaves both open to critical hits.
Seething: Hot blood pours from the wound and sets the target on fire.
Chilling Wounds: You chill the enemy's blood, and it moves slower.
Frenzied Pulse: The electric field around the enemy grows denser, and for a short while you control its bleeding.
Blackout: The target has lost so much blood that it passes out.
Deep Wound: You drive deeper into the enemy's wounds, opening them further and strengthening the bleeding.
Red-hot Hammer: While the enemy is stunned, you manage to set it on fire.
Frozen Ram: After your stun, the enemy still has to thaw out.
Thunderstruck: After you stun the enemy, the lightning keeps it numb a while longer.
Dread Pulse: After the stun you feel the blood of the enemies around race faster: they fear you.
Breach: The enemy is pinned and cannot resist your blows: you find the weak spots and strike them.
Red-hot Point: You pierce the enemy through and set its wounds on fire.
Brittle Mark: You first puncture the enemy, then freeze the puncture site, leaving that spot vulnerable to follow-up hits and raising the critical chance against the enemy.
Piercing Spark: You pierce the enemy through and run a weak current through it, dealing extra damage.
Bloodletting: The bleeding you cause comes from deeper wounds, so it deals far more damage.
Crippling Point: Your blows go so deep that it hurts the target unbearably to move.
